title: Spicy Korean Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and spicy stir fry made with Korean chicken, noodles, and vegetables.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the Korean-Style Chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, Korean chili flakes, and sesame oil to the skillet.
Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Add the noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
Cook the noodles according to package instructions.
Serve the stir-fry over the cooked noodles.
